summary:
The UN climate summit COP31 ended without an agreed deal after the European Union and others rejected a draft declaration that omitted any mention of fossil fuels. The summit had been extended as nations worked overtime, but they could not bridge their differences. Co-hosts Turkey and Australia issued the latest text, which retains global electrification goals but leaves tensions over fossil fuels unresolved. European nations, small island states and activists criticised oil-producing countries for the impasse.

Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial site on Saturday evening, as two tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. The attacks ended a lull in a conflict that began with U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. Tehran reported shooting down a US drone amid stalled efforts to end the war, and Iran has ramped up attacks as the US naval blockade and sanctions hurt its economy.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said at least 14 people were missing after a Russian drone struck a five-story residential building in Dymer, in the Kyiv region, injuring two others. In Indonesia, a fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta killed three people, with 36 still missing, a rescue official said. Fifteen people were rescued alive from the plant.

headlines.title: COP31 climate summit ends without agreed deal
headlines.summary: Nations failed to agree after the European Union and others rejected a draft that omitted mention of fossil fuels. European and vulnerable nations rejected the proposal after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.

headlines.title: Bahrain accuses Iran of striking industrial site
headlines.summary: Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial site on Saturday evening as two tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran has ramped up attacks as the US naval blockade and sanctions hurt the country economically, and it reported shooting down a US drone.

headlines.title: Russian drone strike in Kyiv region leaves 14 missing
headlines.summary: Zelensky said at least 14 people were missing after a Russian drone struck a five-story residential building in Dymer, injuring two others. Rescuers searched a large pile of rubble and helped residents down by ladder and crane platform.

headlines.title: Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland
headlines.summary: The Russia-bound cargo ship was damaged by drones in international waters before drifting into Finnish territory. Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack.

headlines.title: Indonesian confectionery factory fire kills three, 36 missing
headlines.summary: A fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia's Banten province, west of Jakarta, killed three people. Fifteen people were rescued alive, and authorities say the cause of the fire is under investigation.

headlines.title: South Korea education minister resigns over cheating scandal
headlines.summary: Education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal before university entrance exams. He said he failed to prepare adequately, and this year's exams had phones banned and checks for cameras hidden in clothing.

headlines.title: Mexico captures alleged drug lord on FBI most wanted list
headlines.summary: Mexico's military said Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as Chapo Isidro, was captured Friday night in a firefight that left four soldiers and seven suspected gunmen dead. He was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list.

headlines.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal
headlines.summary: The EU and Indonesia signed a trade deal covering 730 million people in Brussels on Saturday. It promises lower tariffs and is set to come into force early next year.
